random_ciphertext.basis: The same page explicitly defines both Sim.UE.Enc and Sim.UE.Upd by this uniform product sampling; no alternative conditional random distribution is supplied

hybrid_specification.sampling_basis: Printed endpoint domain plus stated correct-pair guess probability (T+1)^(-2)
